description: Whole‑genome sequence reference panel used for LD estimation.
official_name_reasoning: The International Genome Sample Resource (IGSR) catalogs the 1000 Genomes Project data using a hierarchical naming scheme. The full Phase 1 release is recorded as “1000GENOMES:phase_1”, and each population group within that release is given a colon‑separated suffix. The European ancestry subset of Phase 1 is therefore officially named “1000GENOMES:phase_1:EUR”. The provided name “1000 Genomes Project (Phase 1, EUR)” describes this European component of the larger Phase 1 dataset, making it a component (population subset) of the overall Phase 1 catalog entry.
